title: A/R reports: the column is named Location and sits in its place
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports > Finance > A/R Summary and read the column headings left to right.
  2. Open Reports > Finance > A/R Detail and read the column headings left to right.
  3. Open Reports > Finance > A/R Collection and read the column headings left to right.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: a column labelled exactly "Location" (new on this report) sits right after the customer name column (the first column), before the money columns.
  • Step 2: the column is labelled exactly "Location" (no longer "Location full name") and sits right after "Date"; "ID" and "Customer full name" keep their names.
  • Step 3: the column is labelled exactly "Location" (no longer "Location full name") and sits right after "Date"; "ID" and "Customer full name" keep their names.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S6-R1: “All six reports have a column labelled exactly "Location". This renames A/R Detail's and A/R Collection's "Location full name" and A/P Detail's and A/P Unpaid Invoices' "Location Name", and adds the column to A/R Summary and A/P Summary.”
  • S6-R3: “It sits right after the Date column, before the money columns; on A/R Summary and A/P Summary, which have no Date column, right after the customer or vendor name.”
  • What changes for existing users: “The A/R column "Location full name" and the A/P column "Location Name" are renamed "Location".”
  • Out of Scope: “Renaming columns other than Location. A/R keeps "ID" and "Customer full name", A/P keeps "No." and "Vendor Name".”
